InquelloWorkspaceExecutionPolicy.description: The Workspace execution policy as the desktop main process fetched it from the shared service (`GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/execution-policy`).

execution.description: The policy's `execution` section in its canonical snake_case form, or null when the policy has none (the conservative Inquello default applies). Validated again here; an invalid section is `invalid`.

description: Computes the effective policy over the Workspace layer (from the params), this runtime's managed requirements (`configRequirements/read`) and the user's own configuration. With a `taskId`, also the Task's broader mode, its status under this policy and the thread settings it would get; only the Task's creator may name it, and the Task must belong to the Workspace.
title: InquelloPolicyEffectiveParams
